CustomField.description: Percent of this group complete. A FORMULA, never a roll-up summary: a roll-up summary can only COUNT, SUM, MIN or MAX, and a ratio is none of those. Mirrors the existing Transaction__c.Completion_Pct__c formula shape exactly so the two read identically. Must be granted editable=false in every permission set - editable=true on a formula field fails the deploy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Percent of the items in this group that are complete. Calculated automatically.
CustomField.label: Percent Complete
